test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Mechanic Diesel) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements regarding the parts associated with the cylinder head is not correct?

options.text: The space enclosed between the cylinder head and the piston top during combustion is the combustion chamber.
Fuel injectors are used to spray fuel into the engine cylinders. They are fixed to the cylinder head.
Spark plugs and cylinder head plugs are fitted through metal screws.
The combustion of fuel and the resulting release of thermal energy create pressure in the casing.

solution:
The correct answer is __The combustion of fuel and the resulting release of thermal energy create pressure in the casing**(Option 4)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The space enclosed between the cylinder head and the piston top during combustion__ is called the combustion chamber.
 
• Fuel injectors are designed to spray fuel into the engine cylinders and are fixed onto the cylinder head.
 
• Spark plugs and cylinder head plugs are fitted through the use of metal screws.
 
• The statement "The combustion of fuel and the resulting release of thermal energy create pressure in the casing" is not correct because the pressure is created inside the combustion chamber, not the casing.
 
• The cylinder head plays a crucial role in enclosing the top of the engine cylinders and ensuring proper combustion.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Engine Cylinder Head:**

 
 
• The cylinder head is a key component of an internal combustion engine.
 
• It houses the combustion chamber, intake and exhaust valves, spark plugs, and fuel injectors.
 
 
 
• **Combustion Chamber:**
 
 
• The combustion chamber is where fuel and air mix and ignite to produce energy.
 
• It is located between the piston top and the cylinder head.
 
 
 
• **Fuel Injectors:**
 
 
• Fuel injectors spray fuel into the cylinders for combustion.
 
• They are precisely controlled to ensure efficient engine performance.
